subject: planner: fix wrong extend predicate simplification for subquery and nested expressions (#59922)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent, scoped to planner changes. The DecorrelateSolver’s `pruneRedundantApply` is now guarded by tracked GROUP BY columns to avoid pruning Apply chains that still provide grouping keys (regression covered by added `TestIssue58451`). No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, or runtime/transaction behavior risks identified in the touched planner code; later history up to `pingcap/master` shows no follow-up fixes specifically targeting this guard.
